dedupe_keys.name: datafev a python framework for development and testing of management algorithms for electric vehicle charging infrastructures

description: datafev—A Python framework for development and testing of management algorithms for electric vehicle charging infrastructures is a software tool described in the paper "datafev—A Python framework for development and testing of management algorithms for electric vehicle charging infrastructures" in Software Impacts (Elsevier, 2023), produced by E. Gümrükcü, A. Ahmadifar, A. Yavuzer and colleagues. The abstract could not be read from the open sources used, so the contents are taken from the title. Coverage: not tied to a place or time; the tool is generic. The linked page gives the code or the package; nothing was installed or run, and the repository link comes from a web search for the article, not from the article page. Licence: not stated (no licence on the Software Impacts record read on 2026-10-01; check the repository). Cost: no charge is stated in the metadata read; the paper's own access terms were not checked. Caveats: written from the paper's title and metadata only, so contents, quality and current availability are unchecked and the description may lag the source. It can support developing and testing management algorithms for electric vehicle charging infrastructure. Related: the paper is the Software Impacts article 10.1016/j.simpa.2023.100467.
